Verses.VerseEn: Ya-Sin. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: By the Qur’an, full of Wisdom,

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: You are indeed one of the Messengers,

Verses.VerseAr: عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: On the Straight Path.

Verses.VerseAr: تَنۡزِيۡلَ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الرَّحِيۡمِ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This is revealed by Almighty, Ever-Merciful,

Verses.VerseAr: لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّاۤ اُنۡذِرَ اٰبَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غٰفِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That you may warn the people whose fathers were (also) not warned. So they are careless and neglectful.

Verses.VerseAr: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلٰٓى اَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: In fact Our Command has proved true against most of them. So they will not believe.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِىۡۤ اَعۡنَاقِهِمۡ اَغۡلٰلاً فَهِىَ اِلَى الۡاَ ذۡقَانِ فَهُمۡ مُّقۡمَحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We have put iron collars round their necks reaching their chins. So they have raised their heads up.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ سَدًّا وَّمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدًّا فَاَغۡشَيۡنٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have set a wall before them and a wall behind them, and We have cast a veil over their eyes so they do not see anything.

Verses.VerseAr: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَاَنۡذَرۡتَهُمۡ اَمۡ لَمۡ تُنۡذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And it is all the same for them whether you warn or do not warn them, they will not believe.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا تُنۡذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِىَ الرَّحۡمٰنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِۚ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٍ وَّاَجۡرٍ كَرِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: You can only warn him who follows the direction and guidance and fears the Most Kind Lord unseen. So give him the good news of forgiveness and a reward of great honour.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡىِ الۡمَوۡتٰى وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوۡا وَاٰثَارَهُمۡؕ وَكُلَّ شَىۡءٍ اَحۡصَيۡنٰهُ فِىۡۤ اِمَامٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We alone raise the dead alive. And We are writing down (the deeds) which they have sent forward and their effects (that are left behind). And We have encompassed everything in the illumining Book (al-Lawh al-Mahfuz).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلاً اَصۡحٰبَ الۡقَرۡيَةِ  ‌ۘ اِذۡ جَآءَهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (in story-telling style) narrate to them the example of the people of a city (Antioch - an ancient city in North Syria), when there came to them some Messengers.

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡهِمُ اثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوۡهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّاۤ اِلَيۡكُمۡ مُّرۡسَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When (at first) We sent to them two Messengers, they rejected them both. Then We reinforced (them) with a third (Messenger). Then the three of them said: ‘Surely we have been sent to you.’

Words.MeaningEn: but they denied both of them

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا مَاۤ اَنۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُـنَا ۙ وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍۙ اِنۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا تَكۡذِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The people of the city) said: ‘You are but human beings like us, and the Most Kind Lord has not sent down anything. You are only lying.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ اِنَّاۤ اِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Messengers) said: ‘Our Lord knows that assuredly we have been sent to you.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَاۤ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there is no binding upon us except to communicate the message expressly.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۚ لَٮِٕنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهُوۡا لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُمۡ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The people of the city) said: ‘An evil omen has reached us from you. If you do not desist, we shall certainly stone you and you will definitely suffer an agonizing punishment at our hands.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا طآٮِٕرُكُمۡ مَّعَكُمۡؕ اَٮِٕنۡ ذُكِّرۡتُمۡؕ بَلۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّسۡرِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Messengers) said: ‘Your evil omen is with you. Is it an evil omen that you are admonished? Nay, but you are a people who exceed limits.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ اَقۡصَا الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ رَجُلٌ يَّسۡعٰى قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اتَّبِعُوۡا الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And a person came running from the farthest end of the city. He said: ‘O my people, follow the Messengers.

Verses.VerseAr: اتَّبِعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّا يَسۡـــَٔلُكُمۡ اَجۡرًا وَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Follow those who do not ask from you any compensation and who are rightly guided.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا لِىَ لَاۤ اَعۡبُدُ الَّذِىۡ فَطَرَنِىۡ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And what is the matter with me that I should not worship Him Who has created me and to Him (all of) you will be returned?

Verses.VerseAr: ءَاَ تَّخِذُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً اِنۡ يُّرِدۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّىۡ شَفَاعَتُهُمۡ شَيْئًا وَّلَا يُنۡقِذُوۡنِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Should I take such gods apart from Him (Allah) that if the Most Kind Lord intends to do me any harm, their intercession would not bring me any benefit, nor would they be able to rescue me?

Verses.VerseAr: اِنِّىۡۤ اِذًا لَّفِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, certainly I would be in open error.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنِّىۡۤ اٰمَنۡتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَاسۡمَعُوۡنِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me (attentively).’

Verses.VerseAr: قِيۡلَ ادۡخُلِ الۡجَـنَّةَ  ؕ قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِىۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The disbelievers martyred him; then it) was said (to him): ‘(Come,) enter Paradise.’ He said: ‘Alas! Would that my people knew,

Verses.VerseAr: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِىۡ رَبِّىۡ وَجَعَلَنِىۡ مِنَ الۡمُكۡرَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That my Lord has forgiven me and put me among the honoured and near ones.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلٰى قَوۡمِهٖ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهٖ مِنۡ جُنۡدٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُـنَّا مُنۡزِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, after him, We did not send any army (of angels) from the heaven to his people, nor were We to send down (angels to destroy them).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ خٰمِدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Their torment) was nothing but a Mighty Blast, and there were they put out (dead like charred coal).

Verses.VerseAr: يٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى الۡعِبَادِ ؔ‌ۚ مَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ah! Woe to (these) servants! Never did a Messenger come to them but they used to mock him.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا كَمۡ اَهۡلَـكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ اَنَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not seen how many communities We destroyed before them, and that now they will not return to them,

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But that all of them will be brought before Our Presence?

Verses.VerseAr: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الۡاَرۡضُ الۡمَيۡتَةُ   ۖۚ اَحۡيَيۡنٰهَا وَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبًّا فَمِنۡهُ يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And a sign for them is the dead earth to which We gave life, and We brought forth from it (grain); then they eat of it.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّاَعۡنَابٍ وَّفَجَّرۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنَ الۡعُيُوۡنِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We produced in it gardens of date-palms and grapes, and also caused some springs as well to gush forth in it,

Words.MeaningEn: and We caused to gush forth

Verses.VerseAr: لِيَاۡكُلُوۡا مِنۡ ثَمَرِهٖۙ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ‌ؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that they may eat of its fruits. And it is not their hands that made it. Do they not thank (even) then?

Verses.VerseAr: سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۡۢبِتُ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Glory be to Him Who created everything in pairs of those the earth grows and of themselves as well and, (moreover,) of the things they do not know.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الَّيۡلُ  ۖۚ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مُّظۡلِمُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (also) a sign for them is the night: (how) We draw the day out from it! So then they are left in darkness!

Verses.VerseAr: وَالشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِىۡ لِمُسۡتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا  ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيۡرُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the sun is always rotating (non-stop) for its appointed destination. It is a measure fixed by Almighty, All-Knowing (Lord).

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰى عَادَ كَالۡعُرۡجُوۡنِ الۡقَدِيۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have also appointed stages (of motion and rotation) of the moon till (its appearance to the dwellers of the earth wanes to) the semblance of an old dry branch of a palm-tree.

Verses.VerseAr: لَا الشَّمۡسُ يَنۡۢبَغِىۡ لَهَاۤ اَنۡ تُدۡرِكَ الۡقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ‌ؕ وَكُلٌّ فِىۡ فَلَكٍ يَّسۡبَحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Neither can the sun (deviate from its orbit and) overtake the moon nor can the night precede the day and all (the stars and planets) are moving in their respective orbits.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمۡ اَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And a Sign for them is (also) that We boarded their fathers (the Children of Adam) into the laden Ark of (Nuh [Noah] and saved them).

Verses.VerseAr: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مِّثۡلِهٖ مَا يَرۡكَبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And like this (Ark) We made for them (many other means of transport) which they ride.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيۡخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡقَذُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if We intend We drown them. Then, there will not be any to respond to their cry, nor will they be saved anyway,

Words.MeaningEn: (would be) a responder to a cry

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا اِلٰى حِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except for Our Mercy and (this) provision is for an appointed term.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوۡا مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when it is said to them: ‘Fear that (torment) which is before you and which is behind you so that you may be shown Mercy.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And not a Sign of the Signs of their Lord comes to them but they turn away from it.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اَنۡفِقُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُۙ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡۤا اَنُطۡعِمُ مَنۡ لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ اَطۡعَمَهٗٓ     ۖ اِنۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ اِلَّا فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when it is said to them: ‘Spend (in the way of Allah) of what Allah has given you,’ the disbelievers say to the believers: ‘Shall we feed that (poor) man whom, if Allah so willed, He would feed (Himself)?’ You are but (caught) in clear error.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they say: ‘When will this promise (of the Last Hour) be fulfilled if you are truthful?’

Verses.VerseAr: مَا يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً تَاۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They are simply waiting for a Mighty Blast which will seize them (all of sudden), and they will be disputing among themselves.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ تَوۡصِيَةً وَّلَاۤ اِلٰٓى اَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then they will not be able to make a will or to return to their families.

Verses.VerseAr: وَنُفِخَ فِىۡ الصُّوۡرِ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ يَنۡسِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (when) the Trumpet will be blown (again) they will come out of the graves at once and run towards their Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا يٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۡۢ بَعَثَنَا مِنۡ مَّرۡقَدِنَاۘؔ؄ هٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Seeing the horrors of the Hour of Resurrection,) they will say: ‘Ah, woe to us! Who has raised us from our sleeping apartments? This (coming back to life) is the same that the Most Kind Lord promised and the Messengers spoke the Truth.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This will only be a Mighty Blast. Then all of them will be brought to Our Presence straight away.

Verses.VerseAr: فَالۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ شَيْئًا وَّلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So today no soul will be wronged in the least. Nor will you be rewarded except for the deeds you used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَـنَّةِ الۡيَوۡمَ فِىۡ شُغُلٍ فٰكِهُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the residents of Paradise will be rejoicing today (in their) favourite pastime pursuits (like spiritual visits, entertainments, sessions of hymns and spiritual musical performance and other favours).

Verses.VerseAr: هُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُهُمۡ فِىۡ ظِلٰلٍ عَلَى الۡاَرَآٮِٕكِ مُتَّكِـــُٔوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They and their wives will be reclining on raised couches under the deep calming shades.

Verses.VerseAr: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَّلَهُمۡ مَّا يَدَّعُوۡنَ‌ ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There they will be provided with fruits (of every kind) and will find (available) everything they will solicit.

Verses.VerseAr: سَلٰمٌ قَوۡلاً مِّنۡ رَّبٍّ رَّحِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: ‘Peace (be upon you)!’ (This) greeting will be conveyed (to them) from the Ever-Merciful Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: وَامۡتَازُوۡا الۡيَوۡمَ اَيُّهَا الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: ‘And, O evildoers, get aside (from the righteous) this Day.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ اَعۡهَدۡ اِلَيۡكُمۡ يٰبَنِىۡۤ اٰدَمَ اَنۡ لَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡا الشَّيۡطٰنَ‌‌ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَـكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O Children of Adam! Did I not take this covenant from you not to worship Satan; no doubt he is your open enemy;

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡنِىۡ  ؔ‌ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that you keep worshipping Me alone? That is the straight path.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَضَلَّ مِنۡكُمۡ جِبِلًّا كَثِيۡرًا‌ؕ اَفَلَمۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely he led great many of you astray, so had you not any wisdom?

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This is the same Hell that was being promised to you.

Verses.VerseAr: اِصۡلَوۡهَا الۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Enter this Hell today, for you kept disbelieving.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلٰٓى اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَاۤ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ اَرۡجُلُهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Today We shall seal their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will bear witness to the deeds which they used to earn.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَـطَمَسۡنَا عَلٰٓى اَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَاسۡتَبَقُوۡا الصِّرَاطَ فَاَنّٰى يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if We had so willed, We would have obliterated the very marks of their eyes. Then if they would have run on the path, how could they have seen?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنٰهُمۡ عَلٰى مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مُضِيًّا وَّلَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if We had so intended, We would have defaced them in their places. Then they would have power neither to go forward nor to turn back.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُـنَكِّسۡهُ فِىۡ الۡخَـلۡقِ‌ؕ اَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And someone whom We give long life, We cause him to degenerate (towards childhood and debility) in strength and disposition. So, do they not have sense?

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنٰهُ الشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۡۢبَغِىۡ لَهٗؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ وَّقُرۡاٰنٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have not taught him (the Holy Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him]) composing poetry, nor does it befit his dignity. This (Book) is but direction and guidance and the illumining Qur’an,

Verses.VerseAr: لِّيُنۡذِرَ مَنۡ كَانَ حَيًّا وَّيَحِقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that it may warn the one who is alive and the word of judgment may be proved against the disbelievers.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡنَاۤ اَنۡعَامًا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مٰلِكُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not seen that We created for them cattle out of the (Creation) We made with Our Mighty Hand; so they are their owners?

Verses.VerseAr: وَذَلَّـلۡنٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوۡبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We subjected those (cattle) to them. So some of them are their riding animals, and they eat some of them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ‌ؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there are other benefits and drinks in them as well for them. Then why they do not give thanks?

Verses.VerseAr: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they have made idols their gods other than Allah with the hope that they will be helped.

Verses.VerseAr: لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَهُمۡۙ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّحۡضَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: These idols are incapable of helping them. And these (disbelievers and polytheists) will be an army of these (idols) that will be brought (into Hell together).

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَا يَحۡزُنۡكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡ‌ۘ اِنَّا نَـعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So let not what they utter hurt you. Surely We know whatever they hide and whatever they make public.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيۡمٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Has man not seen that We have created him from a sperm drop? Even then, he has become an open adversary.

Verses.VerseAr: وَضَرَبَ لَـنَا مَثَلاً وَّنَسِىَ خَلۡقَهٗ‌ؕ قَالَ مَنۡ يُّحۡىِ الۡعِظَامَ وَهِىَ رَمِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And he (himself) puts forth examples for Us and has forgotten (the truth of) his creation. He says: ‘Who will give life to bones when they will have been decomposed?’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيۡهَا الَّذِىۡۤ اَنۡشَاَهَاۤ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ‌ؕ وَّهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘He Who created them the first time will give them life. And He knows best every Creation,

Verses.VerseAr: اۨلَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الۡاَخۡضَرِ نَارًا فَاِذَاۤ اَنۡـتُمۡ مِّنۡهُ تُوۡقِدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He Who produces fire for you out of the green tree so now you kindle fire with the same!

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَيۡسَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰٓى اَنۡ يَّخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۡؔؕ بَلٰى وَهُوَ الۡخَـلّٰقُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And has He Who created the heavens and the earth not the power to create the like of them (again)?’ Yes indeed! And He is the Supreme Creator, All-Knowing.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَاۤ اَمۡرُهٗۤ اِذَاۤ اَرَادَ شَيْئًا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلَ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: His Command (of creation) is only that when He intends (to create) something, He says to it: ‘Be,’ so it instantly becomes (existent or visible and continues becoming).

Verses.VerseAr: فَسُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِىۡ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَـكُوۡتُ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ وَّاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, Glory be to Him in Whose Hand (Power and Control) is the Sovereignty over everything and to Him you will be returned.
